name: What types of property insurance are essential for Florida real estate investors?

mainEntity.name: What types of property insurance are essential for Florida real estate investors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Essential property insurance types for Florida real estate investors include standard homeowners (HO3/HO6) or dwelling fire (DP3) policies, hurricane/windstorm coverage (often a separate deductible), and flood insurance (NFIP or private). Liability insurance is also crucial to protect against tenant or visitor claims. Investors frequently face decisions about the balance between comprehensive coverage and premium costs, particularly when evaluating properties in high-risk zones. We guide clients on assessing which policies best suit their investment strategy and risk tolerance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Essential types include homeowners/dwelling fire, hurricane/windstorm, flood, and liability insurance, balancing coverage with premium costs.
